name: Solidarity
overview: Scripture reveals that true solidarity is grounded in unity and humility among believers, reflecting the oneness we have in Christ Jesus. The psalmist celebrates the goodness and pleasantness of brethren dwelling together in unity, while Paul exhorts believers to be of the same mind, avoiding pride and embracing humility. This unity transcends social, ethnic, and gender distinctions, as all are one in Christ. Above all, love is the essential bond that perfects and holds this unity together, and peacemakers who foster such harmony are recognized as children of God.
